visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wears a gray t-shirt and speaks toward the camera against a dark background. A large green cartoon owl mascot (the Duolingo icon) is displayed in the lower half of the frame with a joyful expression. A small red logo with a face appears in the top-left corner. (2) The visual transitions to a white background where two stylized, featureless human figures—one yellow and one blue—are shown facing each other. Speech bubbles containing Chinese characters appear between them, followed by two yellow glowing lightbulbs appearing above their heads. (3) A yellow thinking face emoji is shown in the center. To its left, a small stack of gold coins sits under the text 'Small Risk,' and to its right, a large wooden treasure chest overflowing with gold sits under the text 'Big Risk.' (4) The screen is filled with hand-drawn style mathematical formulas, geometric sketches, and trigonometric equations surrounding the central emoji. The treasure chest opens further, emitting a golden glow as the formulas float across the screen. (5) The man reappears on screen, alternating with blue silhouettes of figures with their hands on their heads. The words 'So painful' in Chinese repeat around them. A single blue figure is shown with English speech bubbles describing a struggle. (6) The host concludes his talk. A final white screen appears with a red circular logo and the text 'Weisway' in Chinese. A small animation of a hand-shaped cursor clicks the logo, and a 'Like' button prompt appears with blue and yellow colors.
